title: Chapter 701
paragraphs: Chapter 701
Episode 178. Deepening Concern (5)
After returning to the Tikan Outpost riding the red owl, Bale explained that the sword that Jin obtained had the characteristic of 'not disappearing'.
"Doesn't it disappear?"
"Yeah, I thought you knew, but you seem to have no idea."
"It's a sword that was completed while dealing with you for a few days ago. I had a feeling that as soon as I manifested that flame, I could easily suppress you."
Jin still couldn't name the new magical sword.
He had added his name to the secret techniques or finishing moves he received from someone before, but this was the first time he had created a sword himself.

So, it felt awkward to name it. It was even more embarrassing to give himself a grandiose and cool name like the finishing moves of Runcandel, the ascension of Sarah, and the King's sword like Tushinki.
"The flame you possess, once it sticks to the target, it doesn't go out. It probably won't even go out when you die."
"Really? How do you know something I don't?"

"Heh, I have the divine power, so I possess transcendental insight. After you defeated me, I kept pondering what that flame was. If you had cut me that day, I would never have been able to put out that fire on my own."
The power that Bale possessed is the power of the Sun God.
And according to Orgal's explanation, the Sun God is certainly a being with a noticeably higher status than other gods known in this world.
If Bale couldn't extinguish Jin's flame, there was a high probability that those who used lower divine power would be helpless as well.
Of course, the Sun God's power that Bale had was only a tiny part, but even with that, Bale had the status surpassing an ordinary middle to lower-tier god.
"It's interesting, but I just can't believe it."

"I can't believe it either, even after seeing you complete such a flame. That's the realm Sarah was trying to reach... As you are her successor, I'm not too displeased. If Sarah were here, she would have definitely liked it. Try cutting me with that flame."
"All of a sudden?"
"Don't you trust me? And you need to know the effect of that flame for sure when you take revenge for Sarah in the future."
Bale unleashed his power and extended one arm towards Jin, as if to urge him to cut it quickly.
"It's a bit awkward. If the fire, as you said, doesn't go out..."
"[You've reached the realm Sarah desired, and you can't control your flame? There's no way. Cut me quickly. Just scratch me very lightly!]"
Soon, Jin lit a fire on Bradamante and slightly cut Bale's arm. So lightly that even an ordinary person wouldn't need ointment.
"[Ah, it's so prickly and hot!]"
Bale pulled his cut arm out in disgust. Soon, Jin realized that what Bale said was true.
'So Bale really can't extinguish the fire that remains on the wound...'
To demonstrate to Jin, Bale kept summoning a golden aura on his other hand and pressed it against his wounded arm as if to stop the bleeding.
However, the small flame that remained on the wound showed no sign of going out.
No matter how much he covered and rubbed it with his divine power, the faint shape of the flame remained the same.

"[See? Even a being like me can't extinguish it. So it'll be the same for that guy Orgal. His Sun God's divine power didn't seem to be any higher than mine. Unless a being like your phoenix or a god of fire steps in, there's nothing we can do.]"
"Jin, are you back?"
While the two were having their conversation, Hedo and Yuria entered the outpost.
"Yes, Sir Hedo."
Without realizing it, Jin alternately looked at Hedo and Yuria.
It was strange to see Hedo standing with Yuria instead of Sandra.
But strangely enough, Yuria's expression didn't seem good.
"Hello to you too, Yuria?"
"Yeah... Jin, big brother."
"Why do you look so down? Is something wrong?"
Because she's a contractor of Azmill, she has experienced and indirectly witnessed many tragedies since she was young. Her comrades have been particularly concerned about her mental health.
Thanks to them, Yuria has always been cheerful and vivacious.
As a princess, she is also loved by all of Tikan Kingdom because of her sense of propriety.
"No, nothing in particular. I just feel strangely down. That's why Uncle Hedo is trying so hard to cheer me up."
"Hmm... did you know that? Well, you have the power of truth."
When Hedo spoke awkwardly, Yuria smiled.
"Thank you for caring, Uncle. Thanks to you, and seeing that Jin is back safe, I feel a bit relieved."
Yuria had a hunch that her sudden discomfort was because of Jin's safety.
She had a bad feeling when he headed to Kinzelo's headquarters.
"I'm glad I could help. But why is Bale writhing? Is he hurt?"
"[It's because he showed up and he's not extinguishing the fire!]"
"Fire?"
Jin explained what happened and retrieved the fire that remained on Bale's wound.
As Bale had predicted, when Jin's will was transmitted, the fire subsided very easily.
"I also realized that day that you had crossed the wall. But I didn't know the new sword you acquired had that power. Test it on me too."
Jin left the same scratch on Hedo.
He also tried to extinguish the small, dim flame on the wound with his iron-like hand, but it didn't go out.
"Oh... it really doesn't go out. It's not as painful as Bale's to make such a fuss about it, but if it cuts deep, it's gonna be troublesome."
"Do you think it will be hard to bear if it cuts deep?"
"Well, I don't know until I experience it. It's gonna be really painful, like burn patients who didn't get treated in time. This sword, did you name it?"
"Not yet."
"How about Eternity Flame?"
"...Eternity Flame?"

"Yeah, a flame that never goes out. Including me, I think all those who have faced you so far probably felt that way. They probably thought you were a fire that wouldn't go out. Considering the actual effect of the sword, I think it suits well."
"It's too grandiose and embarrassing."
Jin, who was reminded of the moment when Cosmos gave him the nickname 'Black Prince', was embarrassed.
"Usually, when naming a special technique, it's like that. The special techniques you learned would have been named in the same way. If you're okay with it, it seems like a fitting name."
Thus, the name of the special technique became Eternity Flame.
Hedo, satisfied as a fellow warrior that he got to name Jin's sword, was about to take out a cigar, but when he remembered that Yuria was still next to him, he put it back in.
"Did you gain something from your meeting with Kinzelo?"
"I'll explain it carefully in the meeting room."
On the way to the meeting room, Jin carefully looked at Yuria.
Her expression seemed a little better, but her mood was still more subdued than usual.
'I hope Azmill's power isn't implying some dark future for Yuria...'
As soon as they arrived in the meeting room, all of their comrades quickly gathered.
For a while, Jin detailed all the information he had learned from Orgal to them.
About the Sun God, the Demon King Zito, and the role presumably undertaken by Joshua.
Most of the comrades who heard the story felt the same way as Jin.
Their worries deepened even more in their already overwhelmed state.

"Phew, I'm getting a heavy heart at the thought that it's not over even after we get rid of the Evil God. But what can we do? We would have had to confront our temporary allies anyway after the Evil God."
Kashmir was the first to speak.

"If we can't handle all of them, the world will eventually become a place we don't know. Either it changes through purification as Kinzelo claims, or it becomes hell under the Demon King, or Zipple becomes the only god and manipulates history as he pleases, or the Evil God destroys it. So no matter how tough it gets, we have to keep doing what we've been doing."
Even though he was talking about something everyone knew, there was a sense of royal dignity emanating from Kashmir. He was developing a charisma befitting a king.

"As Lord Kashmir said, we should continue to solve problems one by one, step by step, just as we have been doing so far. So for now, we should set aside problems like the Sun God or the Demon King, and focus on Rosa."
"Yes, my lord."

"As you all know, Rosa is getting stronger faster than Orgal expected, and the reason for this seems to be the despair created by Joshua. Orgal has taken charge of him and has decided to verify this fact. As soon as we get the signal, we will coordinate to eliminate him. And..."
Jin looked carefully into the eyes of his comrades.
"I think it would be best to bring the decisive battle with Rosa forward as much as possible."
The thing that strengthens Rosa is not just Joshua's despair.
Chaos, which has spread throughout the world, is eroding ordinary humans.
This is also being suppressed as much as possible by the Vamel Alliance and temporary allies sending missions to polluted areas around the world, but there were limits.
Especially in the Huphester region, the situation was so badly eroded that even they couldn't intervene, so it was no exaggeration to say that half the world was already a cauldron of despair.

"Obviously, the more the battle is delayed, the more despair will be generated. This is just intuition, but Rosa... I think she's waiting for the right time, when we think we are fully prepared. Because that's when we would be at our weakest, and despair would be maximized."
If not for that reason, Jin couldn't accept Rosa, who had such power, staying only in the Sword Garden.

"Of course, I don't mean to attack very quickly. We just need to find a time that Rosa didn't expect. We must avoid the despair that Rosa wants, and aim for the time when Rosa is not yet completed..."
It was a somewhat abstract story, but from the start, understanding that Rosa 'uses despair' was difficult.
Jin and his comrades had to make such difficult inferences each time, and they couldn't be sure of the results.
They were dealing with an entity that had become a wicked god, not a human.

"From today, we will proceed with the work of confirming at least some of these predictions in conjunction with temporary allies. Once we verify, even roughly, the relationship between the speed of Rosa's completion and despair, we will set the date for the final battle."
The moment Jin finished speaking, a member of the Chilsaek rushed into the meeting room.
"Your Majesty, Lord Jin! Lady Mary has just returned!"
"Bring her in quickly!"
Mary had recently set off for a rescue operation for the survivors in Huphester with the Tona brothers and others.
She had just returned from rescuing some survivors, her body full of wounds.
The moment she saw Jin, she closed her eyes tightly, as if in pain.
It was because she had entered Huphester and encountered Diphus.
